verdict.rationale: Fathom lets a user generate an API key in User Settings, and that key reaches meetings recorded by the user or shared to their team. It also offers OAuth for public apps, so credentials are bounded by the user's own data access and admin View permissions. Nothing in the evidence shows per-key scopes, read-only keys, or least-privilege restrictions that could be issued specifically for an agent. Missing for 10: per-key permission scopes, read-only or resource-limited keys, documented OAuth scope granularity, key expiry and rotation controls, and independent corroboration.
